releaseNotes: 优化窗口保护在窗口快速变化或系统唤醒时的状态反馈：短暂读取失败会先等待窗口稳定，只有连续失败才提示保护不可用；保护中的 App 状态改为绿色，设置页新增随语言跳转的 QuitHide 官网入口。
releaseNotesEn: Improves window-protection feedback while windows are changing or the Mac is waking: transient read failures now wait for the window state to settle, and protection is reported unavailable only after consecutive failures. Protected app statuses are now shown in green, and Settings adds a language-aware link to the QuitHide website.
